We will never conquer Carida.|[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]], commenting in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Carida''', originally known as '''Ord Carida''', was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], near the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Caridan (species)|Caridan]] race.

==Features==
This large, high-gravity world was covered in everything from rocky mountains and frozen ice fields, to rain forests full of carnivorous plants, and deserts. As such, this planet was the perfect training ground for combat in difficult terrain. It was an exporter of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], and was ruled by the [[Council of Merchants]], which later shared power with a military administration.

==History==
===The Old Republic===
Originally known as Ord Carida, the planet was colonized by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] some time circa [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> During the [[Seventh Alsakan Conflict|Pius Dea Civil War]], which ended [[Pius Dea]] domination over the Galactic Republic, the Republic's [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit]] played an important role in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Ord Carida|victory]] over the Pius Dea garrison there.<ref name="TEGtW4">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref> During the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], some foragers discovered a crude tunnel burrowing under Carida's largest mountain range, believing it to be the entrance to a fabled ancient [[City/Legends|city]]. Eventually, someone was sent to check the foragers' findings.<ref name="TH">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Ancient City}}</ref>

Carida was the site of a major military training facility, the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]]. The training facilities were offered to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for training an army created by the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="HNN">[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 52|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #52]]</ref> This selfsame facility was converted willingly by the population to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] training center and was home to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] most important [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] program, along with several hundred [[B3 ultra battle droid]]s.<ref name="TNEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The planet remained loyal to the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was an adamant supporter of the Galactic Empire until the bitter end.<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

===Clone Wars===
[[File:Unidentified_Abafar_Jedi_cruiser.png|thumb|left|220px|Separatist forces attempted to destroy the ''Valor'' during a strategy conference.]]

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first year of war, the planet was the site of a [[Battle of Carida (Clone Wars)|victory]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] over the Republic. The Republic's loss at Carida, coupled with other [[Battle of Selonia|recent]] [[Battle at Garos IV|defeats]], led [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to believe that the Republic needed another major victory.<ref name="Wild Space" />

Sometime later in the war's course, Carida was once again under Republic control. The Republic operated a space station, known as the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|''Valor'']], within [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Carida and it was the site of a [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]]<ref name="No Return" /> around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="Death Sentence 1">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> The Separatists, under a [[Unidentified super tactical droid (Carida)/Legends|super tactical droid]], unsuccessfully tried to [[Carida Incident|destroy]] the station during the conference using a derelict bomb-laden [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Jedi cruiser]],<ref name="No Return" /> the ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]''.<ref name="TCWFaceBook">{{Facebook|username=StarWarsTheCloneWars|url=photo.php?fbid=494382640601035|name=''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''|date=2013-01-15|archivefile=File:Memo.jpg}}</ref> Near the end of the war, Republic forces seized a [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] factory on [[Tar Morden]] and acquired many [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|crab droids]], which were then sent to Carida.<ref name="TNEGTD" />

===Imperial Period===
{{Quote|We denounce your foul rebellion of lawbreakers and murderers. You have tried to impress me with the number of other weak-minded systems that have joined your Alliance, but no amount of rabble can erase your crimes against the Empire. Carida will never surrender to your so-called New Republic.|Furgan|<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Acadamy_of_Carida_IH.png|thumb|left|200px|Imperial Academy on Carida]]
The planet also had numerous [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] on it that had been transplanted from other worlds. They were often used for training exercises, pitting stormtroopers or Imperial vehicles against them.<ref name="EaW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref> The planet was also the site of the [[Space Battle at Carida|Battle of Carida]], between forces under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and ships of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]].<ref name="FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

The [[Mountain Terrain Armored Transport|MT-AT]] "Spider Walker" was developed and manufactured here. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Veers]] also tested the first [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] there. Carida was also the homeworld of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]].

Carida originally had two moons, one of which, the [[Mascot Moon]], had the Academy's logo carved into its surface. In [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]], [[Mako Spince]] attempted to remove the logo using [[antimatter]]. Instead of achieving this goal, the moon was destroyed.

After [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], control of Carida fell to Imperial [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Furgan]].<ref name="Jedi Search" />

At some point after the Battle of Endor, the Rebel Alliance, namely [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], considered either recruiting or otherwise containing Carida as part of their long term plans of weakening the Empire's military infrastructure, although [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] expressed that they can only contain the planet in the best case scenario, as recruiting it is out of the question.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Carida had refused to accept the reality the Empire was gone, and was held by its vestiges. Imperial scientists at Carida successfully created [[nano-destroyer]]s, an artificial virus keyed to a target's genetic makeup that was not only incurable but also completely undetectable by conventional medical means.<ref name="CotF" /> When Carida was invited to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to meet with Mon Mothma, Ambassador Furgan attended and managed to infect Mothma by splashing a drink containing the nano-destroyer on her during a party, after which he denounced the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and stated that Carida had no intention of joining them.<ref name="Jedi Search" />

===Destruction of Carida===
{{Quote|Let me talk to Ambassador Furgan now or your planetary system is going to be the galaxy's newest bright spot. I've already blown up a nebula to wipe out a pair of Imperial battle cruisers&mdash;don't you think I'd destroy one minor star to get rid of a planet full of stormtroopers?|Kyp Durron to Dauren|<ref name="CotF" />}}
The planet was destroyed in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]] by Jedi [[Kyp Durron]], under the influence of the spirit of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], using the [[Sun Crusher]], a superweapon that fired torpedoes into a star, causing it to go supernova. Beforehand, Durron requested information on his brother, [[Zeth Durron|Zeth]], who had been forced into the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] program. The Caridans falsely told him Zeth was killed in a training maneuver. In a rage, Durron fired a [[resonance torpedo]] at the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Star/Legends|sun]], and announced they had two hours to evacuate before their world was destroyed. Before its destruction, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Dauren]] contacted Kyp and alerted him that Zeth was in fact, still alive. As the sun came closer to going supernova, many Imperials, including Furgan, evacuated from the planet.<ref name="CotF" />

Kyp raced to the surface to find Zeth, who had been called up to the control room to prove to Kyp that he was still alive, as the Caridans incorrectly believed that Kyp could call off the resonance torpedos and would do so upon learning the truth about his brother. As the sun was close to exploding, Kyp blasted a hole in the roof of the control building using the Sun Crusher and landed in it. Zeth attempted to board the ship but Dauren hit him from behind, causing him to fall. As Dauren attempted to board the ship instead, Kyp sealed the door, preventing him from entering. Zeth shot and killed Dauren with his blaster but was unable to regain enough strength to board the ship, due to Dauren's blow to his head. The sun collapsed and exploded in two massive shockwaves. As Kyp watched, Zeth's body disintegrated in the first wave. Kyp escaped as the second wave cracked the planet in half.<ref name="CotF" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CaridaSurface.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A rancor on Carida]]
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Carida in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The Fakir Sector is actually located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories.
''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' stated that early on in the Clone Wars, Carida was conquered by the Separatists. However, the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five]] episode "[[Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)|Point of No Return]]" shows Carida heavily cordoned by Republic warships, thus back under the Republic banner. Until a source clears up this discrepancy, this article reconciles information from all source material by assuming that Carida fell back under Republic control sometime between these events.
